visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a male host positioned in front of a kitchen background. He has shoulder-length, dark wavy hair and is wearing a black t-shirt and a beaded bracelet on his left wrist. He holds two brightly colored product packages from the brand Laurel, specifically their 'Crystal Small Balls' line. He smiles and gestures enthusiastically towards the viewer. Bold yellow and white Chinese text overlays the scene, stating that a dessert can be made in just five minutes. The lighting is bright and characteristic of a professional studio setup, emphasizing the packaging details and the host's facial expressions. (2) The camera transitions to a top-down close-up shot focusing on hands encased in clear plastic gloves. Using a metal knife, the hands carefully cut open a red cardboard carton typically used for milk tea. Once the box is sliced open, a solid, rectangular frozen block of milk tea is slid out onto a wooden cutting board. The frozen block has a rich, caramel-brown color and a slightly frosted surface texture. The background is slightly out of focus, keeping the viewer's attention on the physical state of the frozen ingredient. (3) The gloved hands hold the frozen milk tea block against a stainless steel grater. With rhythmic movements, the block is shaved down into a transparent, fluted glass bowl. Fine, brown-colored ice flakes, resembling snow or a granita texture, accumulate rapidly within the dish. A text overlay in a pink bubble reads 'shaved into ice sand' in Chinese. The host's face appears in a circular inset at the bottom of the frame, showing a focused and impressed expression as he watches the ice pile up. (4) A variety of toppings are added to the brown shaved ice. Specifically, small, translucent glutinous rice balls with dark centers—identified as tea-flavored—are poured on top. The camera captures the glossy, spherical shapes as they settle on the frosty base. The host then takes a golden spoon, scoops up a portion of the ice and one ball, and brings it to his mouth. He closes his eyes and tilts his head back, conveying a sense of intense culinary enjoyment. (5) An extreme close-up shot focuses on a single translucent ball resting on the golden spoon. As it is bitten, the chewy outer layer gives way to reveal a dark, liquid interior filling that looks like concentrated tea syrup. The background remains the glass bowl filled with the shaved ice. Text appears on the screen praising the 'intense tea and milk fragrance' that explodes upon eating. The visual emphasizes the contrast between the translucent skin and the opaque filling. (6) The host demonstrates a second recipe using a white frozen milk block. The process of cutting, shaving, and topping is repeated with sesame and peanut-flavored versions of the crystal balls. These balls have a similar translucent appearance but with dark grey or light orange fillings visible through the skin. The video concludes with the host holding three different varieties of the product packages, smiling broadly at the camera. The background shows the two completed bowls of shaved ice.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a high-energy male voice speaking Mandarin at a fast pace, immediately grabbing the listener's attention with an enthusiastic greeting. A bright, upbeat pop-electronic background track begins simultaneously, featuring a steady drum beat and shimmering synthesizer pads. The vocal delivery is characterized by high pitch variability and a friendly, professional narrative tone, setting an inviting and energetic mood for the tutorial. (2) As the visual transitions to the food preparation, the audio includes clear, high-fidelity incidental sounds. A sharp 'crinkle' and 'thud' signify the opening of the carton and the frozen block landing on the board. This is followed by a rhythmic, metallic scraping sound as the ice is shaved, which has a distinct high-frequency texture. The music continues at a consistent volume, providing an energetic foundation while the narrator's voice remains dominant. (3) Soft, percussive 'clink' sounds are heard as the spoon touches the glass bowl. The speaker's arousal level spikes as he describes the toppings, his voice rising in both volume and pitch. A stylized 'pop' or 'bubble' sound effect is used to emphasize the appearance of the rice balls. When the host bites into the dessert, a subtle but crisp squelching sound effect is used to represent the chewy texture of the product. (4) The second recipe segment features a repetition of the shaving sounds, though the acoustic texture is slightly softer, reflecting the different density of the milk ice. The narrator's speech rate remains high, using descriptive adjectives with falling intonation patterns to convey satisfaction. The background music maintains its drive, with the bass and synth elements remaining prominent without masking the clarity of the spoken words. (5) In the final phase, the background music swells slightly for the outro. The speaker delivers a final recommendation with a strong, authoritative, and energetic tone, his voice projected clearly. A concluding synthesizer flourish marks the end of the track. The overall audio quality is studio-clean, with a high signal-to-noise ratio and well-balanced levels between the speech, music, and sound effects.
